All tasks are TEST tasks; no retrieval tool was run and nothing was tuned. lib/ of this repo has very few plain functions, so tasks t26-t30 and some packet entries use assigned methods (gold_pending_indexer) and a few symbols are reused across tasks with different behaviours. | Reviewed 2026-10-01: author and reviewer were separate sessions without retrieval tools; review log in evals/out/m12/heldout_express_review_log.md.

tasks.query: split a media type string on semicolons into its value, a numeric q weight defaulting to one, and a map of the remaining key=value parameters
tasks.note: acceptParams slices the value before the first semicolon and loops over the parameters, storing q as a float quality and other keys in params.

tasks.query: factory returning an ETag generator that converts a non-buffer body to a buffer using the given encoding, then computes the tag with the preset options
tasks.note: createETagGenerator returns generateETag(body, encoding), which calls Buffer.from for non-buffers and passes the buffer and options to the etag library.

tasks.query: parse a query string with the qs library while allowing keys that collide with Object prototype properties
tasks.note: parseExtendedQueryString calls qs.parse(str, { allowPrototypes: true }).

tasks.query: create the callable application function that forwards to handle, mixes in EventEmitter and the application prototype, and derives request and response objects bound to it
tasks.note: createApplication builds the app function calling app.handle, mixes in EventEmitter.prototype and proto, creates app.request/app.response with an app property, and calls app.init().

tasks.query: print the error stack, or its string form when there is no stack, to the console unless the environment setting is test
tasks.note: logerror calls console.error(err.stack || err.toString()) unless this.get('env') is 'test'.

tasks.query: call render on a view object inside try/catch so a synchronously thrown exception is passed to the callback instead of propagating
tasks.note: tryRender wraps view.render(options, callback) in try/catch and calls callback(err) on a throw.

tasks.query: when the response finishes, treat ECONNRESET as an aborted request, pass along other errors, otherwise use setImmediate to check the streaming flag before completing
tasks.note: onfinish (nested in sendfile) maps ECONNRESET to onaborted, forwards other errors to onerror and otherwise uses setImmediate to test the streaming flag before calling back.

tasks.query: helper that adds an enumerable, configurable getter-only property to an object using Object.defineProperty
tasks.note: defineGetter(obj, name, getter) wraps Object.defineProperty with configurable, enumerable and get; it is the helper used for the request accessors.

tasks.query: serialize a value to JSON with optional replacer and spaces, optionally escaping angle brackets and ampersands as unicode sequences to prevent HTML sniffing
tasks.note: stringify wraps JSON.stringify and, when escape is set, replaces <, > and & with \u003c, \u003e and \u0026.

tasks.query: stream a send file object into the response, registering directory, end, error, file and stream listeners, and guarantee the completion callback fires only once
tasks.note: sendfile defines the small handlers with a shared done flag, attaches them to the send stream's events, hooks onFinished and pipes the file to res.

tasks.query: synchronously fetch filesystem metadata for a path, yielding undefined instead of throwing when the path is missing or unreadable
tasks.note: tryStat wraps fs.statSync in try/catch and returns undefined on failure; View.resolve uses it to probe candidate files.

tasks.query: report to the completion callback, at most once, that the client hung up mid-transfer, by building a new error carrying a connection-level code
tasks.note: onaborted sets done, builds an Error('Request aborted') with code ECONNABORTED and passes it to callback.

tasks.query: complete at most once with an error coded EISDIR and the message EISDIR, read when the requested path turns out to be a folder
tasks.note: ondirectory sets done and calls callback with Error('EISDIR, read') whose code is EISDIR.

tasks.query: hand a failure raised by the source stream to the completion callback unchanged, unless the transfer was already marked complete
tasks.note: onerror(err) returns if done, otherwise sets done and calls callback(err) with the original error.

tasks.query: mark the transfer complete and invoke the completion callback with no arguments, unless completion was already recorded
tasks.note: onend returns if done, otherwise sets done = true and calls callback() without an error.

tasks.query: reset the local indicator of ongoing body streaming to false once the source reports that it has resolved the item to be served
tasks.note: onfile is the single statement streaming = false, attached to the send stream's 'file' event.

tasks.query: set the local indicator of in-flight body delivery to true once the source reports that it has begun piping the content out
tasks.note: onstream is the single statement streaming = true, attached to the send stream's 'stream' event.

tasks.query: just before the body goes out, copy every entry of a caller-supplied header map onto the outgoing reply using a listener on the source
tasks.note: the options.headers branch of sendfile registers a 'headers' listener that calls res.setHeader for each key; the listener is a function expression inside sendfile, so sendfile is the smallest indexed symbol containing it.

tasks.query: lazily load the template engine module named by the extension, cache it in a shared map, and fail if it lacks an express-style render handler
tasks.note: the View constructor requires the module named by the extension when opts.engines has no entry, checks that __express is a function, and stores it in opts.engines.

tasks.query: if a template name has no extension, derive one from the default engine setting, prefixing a dot if needed, and throw if neither exists
tasks.note: the View constructor throws when there is neither extension nor defaultEngine, otherwise builds ext from defaultEngine (adding a leading dot) and appends it to the file name to look up.

tasks.query: guard a render call so synchronous exceptions reach the callback, plus the constructor that loads the engine module for an extension and resolves the file
tasks.note: tryRender (application.js) catches synchronous render failures; View (view.js) resolves ext and engine handler and the path.

tasks.query: extended nested query strings: the qs-based parse function and the helper that declares the getter-based query property on the request prototype
tasks.note: parseExtendedQueryString (utils.js) is the extended parser; defineGetter (request.js) is the helper through which the req.query accessor is declared.

tasks.query: serialize JSON with optional unicode escaping of angle brackets and ampersands, and build an ETag function that buffers string bodies using a given encoding
tasks.note: stringify (response.js) produces the JSON text with optional escaping of <, > and &; the generator returned by createETagGenerator (utils.js) buffers a non-buffer body with the given encoding before computing the tag.

tasks.query: listeners that hand file transfer failures to a one-shot completion callback, and the default application error hook logging the stack unless in test
tasks.note: sendfile (response.js) reports stream failures through its callback; logerror (application.js) is the default finalhandler error hook that prints to console.error.

tasks.query: request accessors that read application settings: a per-app request prototype carrying an app back-reference, plus the helper that declares each getter
tasks.note: createApplication (express.js) creates app.request with an app property that accessors use via this.app.get; defineGetter (request.js) declares the accessors.

tasks.query: compile the etag setting (true, weak, strong, false or a custom function) into a generator, recomputed by the setter whenever the setting changes
tasks.note: compileETag (utils.js) maps the setting to a generator; app.set (application.js) calls it for the 'etag' case and stores the result as 'etag fn'.

tasks.query: normalize a proxy trust setting (boolean, hop count, address list or function) into a predicate, and make mounted sub-apps inherit the parent's value unless overridden
tasks.note: compileTrust (utils.js) builds the predicate; app.set (application.js) stores it as 'trust proxy fn' and marks the value as explicitly set; the 'mount' listener in app.defaultConfiguration drops the child's default trust proxy so the parent's applies.

tasks.query: respond with the handler whose mime type best matches the Accept header, expanding extension shorthands to full types, or fail with 406 listing supported types
tasks.note: res.format (response.js) picks the key through req.accepts, sets Content-Type with normalizeType and lists normalizeTypes values in the 406 error (utils.js).

tasks.query: render a template from a response: merge its locals, default the callback to sending the result, and have the application find or cache the view
tasks.note: res.render (response.js) merges res.locals and supplies the default callback; app.render (application.js) merges settings, builds or reads the cached view and renders.

tasks.query: mount a nested app under a path: set its mountpath and parent, restore prototypes afterwards, and where the app-specific prototypes get created
tasks.note: app.use (application.js) sets mountpath/parent and restores the request/response prototypes after the sub-app; createApplication (express.js) creates the per-app prototypes.

gold_context.why: createApplication ends with app.init(); init seeds cache, engines and settings and calls defaultConfiguration, so it relies on the mixins and prototypes set up just before.
the returned app function simply forwards (req, res, next) to app.handle, so that signature must stay in sync.
registers a 'mount' listener through this.on (EventEmitter mixin) that rewires this.request and this.response, which createApplication creates.
recognises mounted sub-apps by duck-typing handle and set (supplied through mixin(app, proto)) and emits 'mount' through the EventEmitter mixin.
request accessors declared with it are inherited by app.request (Object.create(req, { app })) and read this.app, the property createApplication defines.
sole caller: passes (view, renderOptions, done) as its last step and relies on tryRender to turn synchronous throws into done(err).
tryRender calls view.render(options, callback); render forces synchronous engine callbacks async, which defines what the try/catch can and cannot catch.
type of the view argument: the object app.render builds with new View(name, { defaultEngine, root, engines }).
supplies the default callback (forward err to req.next, else send(str)) that ultimately receives the error tryRender hands over.
the constructor ends with this.path = this.lookup(fileName); lookup returns undefined when nothing is found and accepts root as string or array.
lookup resolves candidates through View.resolve, which probes the disk with tryStat; its undefined result leaves this.path unset.
constructs the view with { defaultEngine, root, engines } and raises 'Failed to lookup view' when view.path is falsy, so option names and the path property must stay compatible.
registers engine functions under a dot-prefixed extension in this.engines, the same key that the constructor checks in opts.engines[this.ext].
sets the default 'view' setting to this constructor and the default 'views' root that app.render passes in.
maps the etag setting to exports.wetag or exports.etag, which are built by this factory with { weak: true } and { weak: false }, so the option names must match.
for the 'etag' setting it calls compileETag(val) and stores the result as 'etag fn'; for weak or strong that is a function returned by this factory.
the consumer: calls etagFn(chunk, encoding) on the body (a Buffer with undefined encoding after conversion) and only uses a truthy string result.
the only caller: returns acceptParams(type) for slash-containing types and mimics the { value, params } shape for bare extensions.
maps normalizeType over an array, so the shape returned by acceptParams reaches array callers too.
reads normalizeType(key).value and normalizeTypes(keys).map(o => o.value), so the value field produced by acceptParams must be preserved.
returns this function for the 'extended' setting and querystring.parse for simple, so the (str) -> object contract must hold.
for the 'query parser' setting stores compileQueryParser(val) as 'query parser fn'.
sets the default 'query parser' to 'simple'; the extended parser is used only when an application opts in.
the req.query accessor is declared through it; the getter reads 'query parser fn' and calls it with the raw query string, so any change of return type reaches req.query.
calls stringify(obj, replacer, spaces, escape) with the 'json replacer', 'json spaces' and 'json escape' settings, so the positional parameter order must be kept.
second caller with the same argument order; it handles a body of undefined, which stringify can return for unserializable values.
receives the returned text and derives Content-Length and ETag from it, so the string contract matters.
the json settings passed into stringify are read with app.get, whose one-argument form returns this.settings[setting] through app.set.
sendFile's completion callback depends on its error codes: without a user callback EISDIR leads to next(), ECONNABORTED and write errors are swallowed, other errors go to next(err).
caller that passes opts with a headers object carrying Content-Disposition and forwards the user callback, so sendFile's options and callback handling must stay compatible.
sendFile sets opts.etag = this.app.enabled('etag') before handing the options to send.
constructed here as new View(name, { defaultEngine, root, engines }); the resulting view.path decides the 'Failed to lookup view' error.
the final step of app.render; the callback done receives errors thrown synchronously by the engine.
the view.render(options, callback) contract that tryRender invokes; it makes synchronous callbacks asynchronous.
main caller: sets opts._locals from res.locals and supplies the default callback, so the option merge order ({ ...locals, ..._locals, ...opts }) interacts with it.
called with (obj, replacer, spaces, escape) and may return undefined, which jsonp turns into an empty argument when it wraps the body in a callback.
jsonp ends with this.send(body), which sets Content-Length and ETag for the wrapped callback text.
the req.query accessor that jsonp reads (this.req.query[callbackName]) is declared through it.
sets the default 'jsonp callback name' to 'callback' that jsonp reads.
